{{mod}} 

A '''display case''' is a building that shows off the fruits of your fortress in a way your dwarves can appreciate. To build it takes one [[block]], one clear [[glass]] [[box]], and one object to display; the displayed object is both protected from thieves and added to the value of the room and the fortress. Unfortunately, dwarves will not admire the object directly like they might built furniture, but it's still better than stuffing those [[legendary artifact|legendary amulets and figurines]] into a bin.

This mod was [http://www.bay12forums.com/smf/index.php?topic=57243.msg1249306#msg1249306 originally created by user kaypy on the forum], and serves as a great introduction to modding.


To install the mod, add this workshop to your raw/objects/building_custom.txt file:

{{gamedata|
Display case
Requires:
1 unit building material
1 clear glass box
1 object to display
[BUILDING_WORKSHOP:DISPLAY_CASE]
	[NAME:Display Case]
	[NAME_COLOR:7:0:1]
	[DIM:1:1]
	[WORK_LOCATION:1:1]
	[BUILD_LABOR:MASON]
	[BUILD_KEY:CUSTOM_SHIFT_D]
	[BLOCK:1:0]
	[TILE:0:1:'#']
	[COLOR:0:1:0:7:0]
	[TILE:1:1:'#']
	[COLOR:1:1:0:7:0]
	[TILE:2:1:'#']
	[COLOR:2:1:0:7:0]
	[TILE:3:1:147]
	[COLOR:3:1:7:0:0]
	[BUILD_ITEM:1:BLOCKS:NONE:NONE:NONE][CAN_USE_ARTIFACT]
	[BUILD_ITEM:1:BOX:NONE:GLASS_CLEAR:NONE][CAN_USE_ARTIFACT]
	[BUILD_ITEM:1:NONE:NONE:NONE:NONE][CAN_USE_ARTIFACT] }}


Then, in raw/objects/entity_default.txt add this line under [ENTITY:MOUNTAIN]:

 [PERMITTED_BUILDING:DISPLAY_CASE]


That's it. Now every dwarven civilization you generate will be able to create "display case" buildings. (Note that generating a new world is necessary to pick up the changes to the mountain entity; if you want to add display cases to an existing world you can "re-purpose" the soap makers workshop or screw press workshops.) To build a display case, use {{k|b}}, {{k|w}}, {{k|D}}.
